image_description: A medium shot of a woman with gray hair in a maroon jacket standing on grass, holding a colorful ribbon attached to a tall pole. A child in a red jacket is lying on the ground nearby, also interacting with the ribbons. The pole is decorated with a spiral of colorful fabric/flowers. In the background, there are trees and a fence.
